value_binding_requirement.rule: Any rule depending on an upstream categorical value must reference an explicit frozen binding built from the real cross-year categorical dictionary; unknown values remain raw and unclassified.

global_rules: Definitions are evaluated independently; passing one never implies another passed.
Create one record for every qualifying evidence tuple unless a definition explicitly states first-qualifying resolution; never select a preferred object or school.
Availability equals the maximum availability of all mandatory inputs and the resolving closed bar when one is required.
Creation records are immutable; later state, contradiction and invalidation are append-only.
No future-return, MFE, MAE, PnL, profitability, entry, stop, target, size or preferred-direction field may participate in a definition.
No implicit horizon exists. Definitions requiring a later event resolve at the first qualifying later closed bar/event; if none exists before annual end they are right-censored.
All price comparisons use frozen precision and tolerance rules from FROZEN_CONFIG; equality never silently substitutes for strict inequality.
All upstream objects are read-only and retain their original IDs; Group 8 may relate them but may not rediscover or relabel them.

pa_candle_anatomy.enumeration_rule: one record per eligible closed source bar
pa_candle_anatomy.degenerate_rule: zero_range stores ratio features null and degenerate=true

pa_inside_bar_strict.enumeration_rule: one record per passing adjacent-bar tuple

pa_inside_bar_edge.enumeration_rule: one record per passing adjacent-bar tuple

pa_outside_bar_strict.enumeration_rule: one record per passing adjacent-bar tuple

pa_outside_bar_edge.enumeration_rule: one record per passing adjacent-bar tuple

pa_body_engulfing.pass_rule: current.body_lower <= previous.body_lower and current.body_upper >= previous.body_upper and current.body > 0

pa_directional_body_engulfing.pass_rule: body engulfing passed and current/previous directions are opposite and non-neutral

pa_pin_bar_like.pass_rule: not degenerate and dominant_wick_to_range >= config.pin_dominant_wick_ratio and body_to_range <= config.pin_max_body_ratio and opposite_wick_to_range <= config.pin_max_opposite_wick_ratio
pa_pin_bar_like.direction_rule: lower dominant wick => bullish_rejection_shape; upper dominant wick => bearish_rejection_shape; equality => ambiguous_no_direction

pa_rejection_close.pass_rule: not degenerate and rejection_wick_to_range >= config.rejection_min_wick_ratio and close is in the opposite outer config.rejection_close_outer_fraction of range
pa_rejection_close.direction_rule: lower rejection wick => bullish_rejection_shape; upper rejection wick => bearish_rejection_shape

pa_context_linked_rejection.enumeration_rule: one record per qualifying (rejection_pattern_id, upstream_object_id); no nearest/best selection
pa_context_linked_rejection.pass_rule: pattern range overlaps source object or minimum distance <= max(one verified price increment, config.context_proximity_atr * causal_atr14)

pa_bounded_range_context.enumeration_rule: within each Group4 layer independently, select the causally active zone with greatest upper strictly below reference close and the causally active zone with smallest lower strictly above reference close; ties create all tied pairs; lower_zone.upper < upper_zone.lower required
pa_bounded_range_context.causal_status_rule: zone availability and only zone interactions/transitions available by reference_bar.available_at determine active state; final year-end status may not be read as historical state
pa_bounded_range_context.pass_rule: both boundaries exist and upper_boundary > lower_boundary
pa_bounded_range_context.availability: max(reference bar, both zones, causal state evidence)
pa_bounded_range_context.invalidation_rule: first later available transition/break event that invalidates either locked boundary

pa_breakout_exact.enumeration_rule: one record per qualifying (bar_id,boundary_source_id,boundary_side); all boundaries are evaluated independently
pa_breakout_exact.pass_rule: bullish: close > locked upper boundary; bearish: close < locked lower boundary

pa_breakout_point_buffer.enumeration_rule: same independent boundary enumeration as pa_breakout_exact
pa_breakout_point_buffer.pass_rule: bullish close >= upper + one increment; bearish close <= lower - one increment

pa_breakout_atr_buffer.enumeration_rule: same independent boundary enumeration as pa_breakout_exact
pa_breakout_atr_buffer.pass_rule: bullish close >= upper + config.breakout_atr_buffer * ATR; bearish close <= lower - buffer

pa_failed_breakout.resolution_rule: resolve at the first strictly later closed bar whose close crosses the same locked boundary back to the pre-break side; no maximum bar horizon
pa_failed_breakout.ordering_rule: resolving bar close_time and availability_time are strictly greater than breakout availability
pa_failed_breakout.right_censor_rule: annual end when no qualifying return occurs

pa_retest.eligibility_rule: at least one fully intervening later bar has no overlap with the locked boundary/buffer band
pa_retest.resolution_rule: first later eligible bar whose range overlaps the locked boundary or original locked buffer band; no maximum horizon
pa_retest.right_censor_rule: annual end if no eligible retest

pa_structural_pullback.enumeration_rule: one hypothesis per qualifying (group3_state_id, group6_leg_id) within each Group3 layer; no preferred layer
pa_structural_pullback.pass_rule: counter-direction leg availability occurs while referenced protected structure has no already-available invalidation
pa_structural_pullback.invalidation_rule: referenced protected structure invalidates or later Group3 structural transition in opposite regime becomes available

pa_continuation_after_pullback.resolution_rule: the first qualifying later validated displacement completes the continuation hypothesis; additional later qualifying legs are stored as evidence only
pa_continuation_after_pullback.invalidation_rule: protected structure invalidation or opposite Group3 transition before completion

pa_exhaustion_failed_breakout.enumeration_rule: one hypothesis per exact failed-breakout/rejection tuple that references the same locked boundary interaction
pa_exhaustion_failed_breakout.pass_rule: directions are consistent with rejection back through the failed boundary
pa_exhaustion_failed_breakout.invalidation_rule: later valid close-through breakout of the same locked boundary

dow_advancing_structure.pass_rule: state active_bias or sequence_bias is in frozen advancing binding

dow_declining_structure.pass_rule: state active_bias or sequence_bias is in frozen declining binding

dow_indeterminate_structure.pass_rule: state active_bias or sequence_bias is in frozen indeterminate binding

dow_bullish_transition.pass_rule: event type and direction are in exact frozen bindings and event outcome is accepted by frozen adapter
dow_bullish_transition.invalidation_rule: later opposite structural transition or protected bullish structure invalidation

dow_bearish_transition.pass_rule: event type and direction are in exact frozen bindings and event outcome is accepted by frozen adapter
dow_bearish_transition.invalidation_rule: later opposite structural transition or protected bearish structure invalidation

dow_protected_pullback.pass_rule: both records reference the same Group3 state/protected structure identity

wyckoff_range_context.enumeration_rule: one interpretation per exact bounded-range/Dow-state tuple; no preferred range
wyckoff_range_context.pass_rule: range and structure contexts overlap in symbol,timeframe,layer and causal time scope

wyckoff_spring_candidate.pass_rule: event source pool anchor/range is within frozen proximity of locked lower range boundary; one of is_sweep/is_stop_run/is_false_breakout is true; reclaimed=1; resolution is causally available
wyckoff_spring_candidate.invalidation_rule: later exact close-through below same locked lower boundary

wyckoff_upthrust_candidate.pass_rule: event source pool anchor/range is within frozen proximity of locked upper range boundary; one of is_sweep/is_stop_run/is_false_breakout is true; reclaimed=1; resolution is causally available
wyckoff_upthrust_candidate.invalidation_rule: later exact close-through above same locked upper boundary

wyckoff_sign_of_strength.pass_rule: displacement and breakout share timeframe context and breakout occurs at or after displacement causal availability
wyckoff_sign_of_strength.invalidation_rule: later pa_failed_breakout of same upper boundary

wyckoff_sign_of_weakness.pass_rule: displacement and breakout share timeframe context and breakout occurs at or after displacement causal availability
wyckoff_sign_of_weakness.invalidation_rule: later pa_failed_breakout of same lower boundary

wyckoff_last_point_of_support.pass_rule: retest close is on breakout side and no failed breakout was already available
wyckoff_last_point_of_support.invalidation_rule: later failed breakout below same upper boundary

wyckoff_last_point_of_supply.pass_rule: retest close is on breakout side and no failed breakout was already available
wyckoff_last_point_of_supply.invalidation_rule: later failed breakout above same lower boundary

wyckoff_accumulation_hypothesis.pass_rule: spring availability strictly precedes sign-of-strength availability within same immutable range context

wyckoff_distribution_hypothesis.pass_rule: upthrust availability strictly precedes sign-of-weakness availability within same immutable range context

wyckoff_reaccumulation_hypothesis.pass_rule: advancing context availability precedes range-context availability

wyckoff_redistribution_hypothesis.pass_rule: declining context availability precedes range-context availability

ict_liquidity_sweep_displacement.pass_rule: Group6 evidence source_group/source_id resolves to exact available Group5 event and post-sweep displacement direction is stored without future outcome claim

ict_mss_fvg_delivery.pass_rule: associated Group3 event exists, is causally available and event_type is in frozen MSS/BOS binding; FVG belongs to its stored displacement leg

ict_premium_discount_context.pass_rule: range upper > lower; close < midpoint => discount; close > midpoint => premium; exact equality => equilibrium
ict_premium_discount_context.enumeration_rule: one interpretation per exact (bounded_range_context_id,bar_id); no preferred dealing range

ict_return_to_imbalance.pass_rule: lifecycle record references exact Group6 object and occurs strictly after object availability

ict_block_delivery_context.pass_rule: stored Group7 source IDs prove the relation to Group6 delivery; every qualifying Group7 definition remains independent

ict_draw_on_liquidity_context.pass_rule: draw state and target pool are already available; store location/direction relation only, never whether target will later be reached
